name: – Tomas Tobé – After § 104 – Am 8
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 104a. Calls on the Member States to prevent political parties, elected representatives and candidates from being denied essential banking services or financing solely on the basis of their political views or lawful activities; calls for transparent and objective criteria, effective remedies and appropriate safeguards against politically motivated account closures or financial discrimination, without prejudice to applicable anti-money laundering and financial regulatory requirements;
